column1: # TR39 confusable sources grouped by the script of their prototype (#963).
# `sources` is how many single-code-point sources in confusables.txt 17.0.0 have a
# prototype in this script; `folded` is how many of those some bundled fold
# table reaches. A script with no bundled table reports `0 of N` rather than
